title: Mistral CEO: Don't Let Anthropic Scan French Military Code
caption:
Mistral AI's CEO issued a stark warning: letting foreign AI models scan military code is a direct threat to national sovereignty. The debate over data security vs. AI ambition is heating up.

Flowi cuts through the noise on critical AI policy. Tap the link in bio to BUILD for the field guide.
